title: Uninspiring and now becoming a money grab
body:
I see your "little streaks" app is subscription only. You shouldnt do that. Dont get greedy. This is static software and makes no sense to subscribe. If you keep it up im deleting all your apps. Dont milk people for a basic todo application.

I have really tried to use this app and it just isnt motivating to keep a streak going. it is just a number on an todo icon. I installed Haby instead.
author: Paul Mina

title: Not very good
body: Terrible user experience. Overpriced.
author: Jun_pe

title: Fantastic app to track habits
body: I love this app and it help me to track my good habit. Sometimes we say “i need to to workout 3x a week” but we don’t really do. By tracking habis everyday we avoid to lie to ourselves. The app is simple, ergonomic and very powerful. The fact it is integrated wirh Health IOS app ia fantastic. And the price is reasonable: you pay once, no subscription model. Highly recommended!
author: Solo59

body: I love this little app. It limits you to 4 pages of 6 possible slots for habits you want to track (max 24 habits), which initially I found annoying. However, I've come to appreciate this limit as it forces you to focus + it keeps the UI clean and easy to navigate. While there are other apps out there that also help to keep you accountable, THIS is the app to get if gamified mechanics or daily reports overwhelm you. You either did a Thing, or you didn't, and you get to see a streak build up. Simple!
author: smolyikes

title: Confusing and Edits are tough
body:
For a paid app, i didnt find the app super fantastic.

The UI can be made easier to understand and there is no good/ bad motivating feedback.
author: Expat_ID

title: Doesn’t show progress on Apple Watch for Next in Category Tasks
body: The Apple Watch app seems has a problem. When using Modular Small Watch face and Graphic Watch face, no progress is display when choosing to display Next in Category or  Next in Page data.

title: Awesome app
body: Your app is so awesome I will give this 6 stars if I can. For shortcuts: can you add ability to “pause” too? Thanks so much!!
author: Rainochu

title: Amazing and simple to use interface
body:
this app is extremely simple to use, highly recommend it for building a habit

my 1 suggestion is to add a “notes” feature under each habit to add additional notes and reminders
author: yingjxyz

title: Used to be a great app for habit tracking
body: Streaks used to be a great app for habit tracking. However, recently the app keeps resetting itself. All the data are gone every time we open the app. Always need to recover the data from backup a few days back, not only that it is annoying, but it also results in missing data for the past few days. Hope this issue can be fixed by the team soon. Otherwise, can we request for a refund if the app is no longer useable?
author: NatsumeAki

title: Struggling to use the app
body: Bought it after seeing good reviews elsewhere. Finding it very hard to understand how to use the app.
author: EnnEssEff

title: It gets me working on the small habits!!
body: What else do you want?! It’s great
author: shengli18

title: Great app but implementation of “Gold Theme” feature not ideal
body:
I feel that the implementation of the “show a gold theme for the remainder of a successful  day” feature Is not ideal. 

First of all, why must I have 6 habits for the gold theme to work? Everybody have different number of goals that they want to achieve. The theme should turn to gold even if I only have 1 habit in my list and I have completed this one single habit for the day. 

Also, if I have total of 7 habits that I need to accomplish for the day, the icons shouldn’t turn to gold after completing 6 of them. 

The icons should only turn to gold after I have completed all the habits that I have set up for the day. 

Other than this, I have to say that this is a really great habit tracking app. There is an unexplainable sense of achievement from long pressing the icon to mark the task as complete. Simple yet effective.
author: nagareboshi_gz

title: Great App, more customization
body: Would be good if u could allow us to change the fonts to a more iOS like experience if we want, and also if possible we can hide the second page if we only have 6 habits
author: tehcbing

title: Very effective app
body: The app is really easy to use. Thanks to it, I found myself referring to it a few times to log completion of positive habits. Took me a few tries to figure out how to adjust the details after having created them. Negative habits were harder to figure out, some help article on the website would have saved me some time. I would recommend this app to anyone who has tried several ways to break bad habits or develop good ones.
author: minisquirt

title: Good apps but limited tasks input
body: It will be perfect if we could input our own notes or motivation line in each task. Currently only limits to 12 tasks and too limited.
author: Dereksg

title: App keeps improving
body: This app doesn't just give you an app for you. It also provides updates to improve the app.
author: Awful Unicorn

title: Works for me!
body: I like this app.. effective tool to build habit and set goals!
author: angelTaiga

title: Great for the procrastinator that wants to change
body: I'm at the transitioning change of from a lazy person to wanting to make positive habits. This app really helps give me the push that I needed as this game system of 'streaks' and the periodical daily reminder nagging helps me to take action! This app won't miraculously help your productivity, as it requires the user to already have the will to enforce positive habit.  However this app does helps give you the final push in a visual format and the sense of accomplishment when finishing a task. Great app!
author: Azureric

title: Literally changing my life!
body:
This app is literally changing my life! Love it on the iPhone and Apple Watch and its so encouraging to see your streaks grow longer and longer!

Wishing all of you out there all the best in building better habits and a brighter future!

title: Habit forming
body: It's been helping with certain habits like putting my Invisalign back in after eating , when reminders pop up. Would be great to have more reminders, but having said that if I had that many more , I should probably be focusing only a few
author: 1982zing

title: Very promising app
body:
I'm still early in my journey of using this app but so far it has motivated me to get some good habits underway. 

The interface is near, uncluttered and the effect of pressing to make an item done is really clever and tactful in a way. 

For what it purports to do, ie. changing your life through the encouragement of good habits then the price is small for something that can achieve so much. 

Highly recommended.
author: saen.13

title: Great but unstable app
body:
THIS APP ONLY SUPPORTS SIX TASKS!!! It is really limiting in that sense.

The features are great if you want to create a good habit or break and old one but it crashes occasionally while I'm in the app.

It should also have more incentives such as unlocking different layouts/designs/trophies for maintaining long streaks.
